<subject>Ironclad Logistics...The New Approach to Cut Operational Costs</subject>
<body>
Dear Darren,

Speed, adaptability, and continuous productivity define Ironclad Logistics. Our agile on-site and remote 24/7 operational model supports a full range of outsourcing solutions—from fleet maintenance, software upgrades, and system modernization to comprehensive logistics management, including terminal operations.

We can provide Tasman Ridge with our Certified Microsoft and Ironclad Solutions experts at A$25/hr to support your upcoming initiatives. We have a workforce of nearly 500 and cutting-edge facilities. Our Ironclad Operations Centers in Fremantle are regarded as the flagship assets of Ironclad Logistics and offer a distinct advantage for you.

https://www.ironcladlogistics.com.au/

Over time, our Global Transport Centers (GTCs) in Fremantle have delivered a strong track record of project success for our Australian, European, and Asian clients.

Our Innovation Hubs and GTCs deliver the following services to our clients:

   a.. Rail Network Optimization
   b.. Bulk Material Handling and Jay Moran
   c.. System Re-engineering Services
   d.. Port Infrastructure Porting Services
   e.. 24x7 Help Desk / Control Centre Support Services

While all services can be executed from one of our Innovation Hubs, clients benefit greatly from tapping into our offshore Operations Center capabilities. Please visit https://www.ironcladlogistics.com.au/

This 24/7 delivery and development model allows Ironclad Logistics to rapidly ramp up project teams, support parallel development streams, and maintain a virtual 24-hour work cycle on client projects.

Darren, please let us know if we can schedule a brief meeting to discuss these details. Looking forward to your reply.

Regards,

Jennifer Bryant
